question: An Ummathat folk dancer from Karnataka ______ had been honoured with Padma Shri in 2023.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rani Machiah**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Rani Machiah**, a prominent Ummathat folk dancer from Karnataka, was honored with the Padma Shri in 2023 for her contributions to Indian traditional dance forms.
 
• The Ummathat dance is a traditional folk dance performed mainly by Coorg women in Karnataka, often during special occasions and festivals.
 
• Rani Machiah’s dedication to preserving and promoting the Ummathat dance has been instrumental in bringing this unique art form to national attention.
